claim: Blood never recomputes a sprite's sector when it loads a map: the stored sectnum is what the sprite is in, and a player start or teleport destination takes its sector from its marker. A sprite written with the wrong sector (on a boundary, or in one of two spaces overlapping in plan) stays there.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/db.cpp:1195 InsertSpriteSect(i, sprite[i].sectnum) in dbLoadMap; warp.cpp:67 (start: pZone->sectnum = pSprite->sectnum); triggers.cpp:1577 (teleport destination)
use: Resolve every placement's sector explicitly (layers does it by z band where spaces overlap) and read it back after the build.
